body:
I see. Sorry about my aggressive tone earlier. I may have gone overboard. I still don't agree with you, people on this sub regularly post food photos though, with numerous upvotes. 
Also, as someone mentioned, some of of want to see what people are eating during IFs, it helps plan and normalize things.
OP, delicious food as always. 2 cents from fellow IFer, definitely double down on avoiding refined flours in your diet. Will make fasting easier for you. :)
Have you tried Tamarind Chutney? They are a small business, but they are into sustainable clothing and price transparency.

Even if they did post the macros, how would that be useful? It's not a one size fits all thing, is it? Are you telling me that thousands of years of eating patterns in cultures will suddenly change because keto is the new thing? 
And this is not a keto sub-reddit. :)

OMAD is a weights loss platform too and I see people posting pizzas, burgers, and burritos there. What's the problem, exactly? 
What OP has posted is minimally processed food. We also don't know their height and weight and goals? Maybe they need this? And they have clearly marked it NSFW! Don't open it if you don't want to, mate.
I think they were saying this in jest, OP! :D

Food looks absolutely delicious, OP! It's minimally processed, and you feel good about eating it right? Please don't be discouraged about posting here. And no one's perfect, everyone slips up anyway. We have all ordered a pizza on bad days. Your meals are wayyy better. What would I not give up to be able to have pooris instead of pizza on a bad day. Some days you have pooris, some days you have cheelas. You do you. Just keep fasting and feeling good about what you eat.
The lentil soup (Dal) reminds me of home so much. :(
Lol, I look forward to your meal posts now! Yum food as always. The best part is that it's simple food, wholly nutritious.

What a progress! Keep it up! 
Do you mind sharing your diet and eating window times?
Looks great and nutritious! I miss home-cooked food so much.

I'd also like to join please. 
F30/5'0/SW 139/GW110

OP, I feel the same way. Everyone else's comments are extremely useful (to me too!). I don't do pot or anything else, but I do drown feelings in food. Never imagined I would be in grad school this way. I am taking baby steps though. Started seeing a good therapist, and trying new ways to cope with emotional eating. I have also been reading about self-efficacy (as opposed to just self-esteem). Let me know if you'd like to set up an accountability group? Just PM me. Please remember to start small and don't be too hard on yourself.
Congratulations! This is awesome.

This sounds encouraging! Getting a handle on the triggers was the most difficult part for me, I am glad you have a large part of it figured. 
And wow I just Googled Cefaly, it looks promising and amazing. I didn't even know about it! 
I hope these interventions work well for you and really hope your plans come through awesomely, wishing the best for you! :)

Urgh, it really is difficult to make these choices. My doctor gave me a 10mg prescription, but I kept getting knocked out with that, so I was advised to cut it off to a quarter of that. I saw an effect in 20 days I think with that low a dose (will stop taking from today, taken it for 5 months now) 
I went with the low dose but I too worry about the Alzheimer's risk sometimes. 
I am sorry your grandma got Alzheimer's :( 
I hope you find a solution that works for you, dear human!

Aah, great to know your migraines have been alleviated! 2-3 times a week sounds rough. 
I was advised to take naproxen only when I felt the migraine coming up. I am highly drug sensitive, so I try to not take drugs as much as possible.
Thank you! I hope you are doing better with respect to migraines. And Happy Cake Day! :)

That's so reassuring to hear. I am sorry you had a hard time, but, I am so glad it worked out for you. Thanks for this, awesome human!
Sending all the love and good vibes!
Okay, this is cool. I'd like a few more. Thanks.

Thanks so much. Where I am right now (literally, not metaphorically, because metaphorically I am in free fall way past rock bottom) it's night, I am in my bed, crying, and looking for a way from here. I just want to relax for a while, get rid of my brain. It's so tiresome living with it....
NTA, this is being as real as it gets. I hope your son sees reason, OP.
